snapshot.scope: Independent Product Planning review of exact external-root reconnect: Main owns the chooser and private dependency identity, BackupRestoreService proves and persists the same stable binding, BackupCoordinator resumes only the same reread Job from current truth, generic retry cannot bypass repair, and statuses remain unchanged.

reviewers.independence: Product Planning reviews only contracts, trace and protected verifier coverage; Development owns schemas, services, IPC, renderer, locale, tests and runtime evidence.

dimensions.summary: One waiting Backup owns one chooser, exact binding repair and same-Job continuation; cancel and failure create no second durable work.
Source, Job, Settings, API and UI owners agree that current external truth—not waiting metadata—authorizes resume.
Backup and waiting-dependency open work becomes exact while every Requirement/Exit/Phase status remains unchanged.
Canonical schemas, two service owners, one registrar and one bounded UI component give Development and UI exact handoff boundaries.
Existing owner documents carry request, storage, retry and visible-state facts; no new design document or architecture phase was added.

verification.command: npm run verify:verify-scripts-integrity && npm run verify:contracts
verification.evidence: The protected explicit registrar list still rejects missing or undocumented channels and binds the future Backup/Restore registrar.

verification.command: npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:decisions && npm run verify:documentation-leanness
verification.evidence: Owner links, durable decision structure and governed byte limits pass without a new document.
Backup reconnect remains open work and every Requirement/Exit/Phase status is unchanged.

coordination.compatibility: Failed-retryable Backup behavior and referenced-original handling are unchanged; this contract repairs only an external managed-copy dependency for one waiting Backup.
coordination.acknowledgement: Product Planning freezes the contract; implementation, UI, locales, tests, runtime evidence and status promotion remain outside this candidate.

nonBlockingRisks: Development must prove chooser cancel, stale/not-found/failed, wrong/empty/symlink directory, source drift, binding write/reread, metadata-only retry denial and restart recovery.
UI Design must prove focus return, pathless localized settled states and polling convergence without a renderer jobs.retry call.
